user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to rotate and raise/lower an internal platform by 80-100 mm while supporting 1 kg payload, with the mechanism enclosed inside the housing, safe, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A compact desktop lifting device that enables manual lifting of a payload by rotating an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform within a specified vertical range while maintaining safety, mechanical plausibility, ease of assembly, and manufacturability.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box.
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform.
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg.
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing.
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable.
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed.
